column1: 5.5.4.2.20.33 Enable Encryption / Decryption. User shall click on this menu item to
enable or disable Encryption/Decryption for required sub-systems. A GUI, as shown in
Figure-5.230, shall be displayed to user. If Operator selects ‘Enable’ for subsystem, data
and commands between SCD and the selected sub system will be encrypted & decrypted.
